findings.one_line: The proposal's finite compatible recession library with an input-computable vanishing ledger is still an open question; common-ray coherence plus per-library inequalities is a strictly weaker kernel and cannot deliver the advertised unconditional CertGluePFL certificate.

The theorem does not position its same-law quantile-effect endpoints and response-type fiber against the accepted-bank partial-transport result pid_slate_benefit_partialtransport_v1, which shares the survivor-complier IV/selection substrate; it must state the exact distinction from that result and from the closest published Job Corps/sample-selection bounds.

The stated estimand-functional remains a bare infimum/supremum over F(p); the finite response-type polytope and threshold-pair programs are only dispersed through supporting definitions, so lift the explicit observed-law evaluation algorithm and its finite constraints into this theorem/functional.
